meta.rule: walk-forward: each test season fitted on seasons before it only; 2026 never read
meta.eval_rows: played in role, 3+ earlier role games (the stand-in lines need them)
meta.crps: sum over integer k of (F(k) - 1{y<=k})^2, k over each stat's range

subgroups.book_like: trailing 5-game mean at or over a book-like floor {"passing_yards": {"QB": 120}, "rushing_yards": {"QB": 12, "RB": 20}, "receiving_yards": {"RB": 12, "WR": 15, "TE": 15}, "rush_rec_yards": {"RB": 30}}
subgroups.starter: this week's chart rank within the starter slots {"QB": 1, "RB": 1, "WR": 3, "TE": 1}
subgroups.backup: not a starter by that rule
subgroups.promoted: a starter this week who was not one at his previous role game
subgroups.thin_hist: fewer than 8 career games before this one

verdict: qgbm (the LightGBM quantile grid) is the candidate: lowest pooled CRPS of the four candidates on every stat, on all rows and on book-like starters, and better than cur in every stat-season on all rows (on book-like starters in 18 of 20, level in 2 of them). qgbm_cal is reported, not chosen: its recalibration, fitted on every row of season s-1, leans the book-like starters 2-5 points toward the under. These are stand-in lines, not DraftKings'; the frozen 2026 test decides.
